public_rationale: OpenAI announced Sora Turbo's release to ChatGPT Plus and Pro users on December 9, 2024, following its February preview [e1]. The same announcement states that the deployed version often generates unrealistic physics and struggles with complex actions over long durations [e1]. This establishes paid public access and recurring physical inaccuracies in the December release described by the claim [e1].
limitations: The announcement does not quantify the physical-error rate or independently reproduce the examples in the post.
The evidence concerns Sora Turbo at its December 2024 release and does not establish the performance of later versions.

The passage concerns the December 2024 release and its condition through 2025-01-05, so the target period begins 2024-12-01.
criteria.support_condition: A dated release record establishes public consumer access by the post date, and contemporary primary evidence documents recurring physical inaccuracies in the released model.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The model was not publicly accessible by the post date, or representative evaluations establish reliable physical behavior that directly rebuts the alleged recurring limitations.
